newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down to new 26-month low.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down to new 26-month low.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price ended two cents down at 13.98 ringgit ($5.57) a kg to hit a new 26-month low on Friday.
Traders said the fall, breaking the earlier 26-month low of 14 ringgit on Thursday, was due to a weaker overnight close on the London Metal Exchange (LME).
"I think we'll see some strong support at this level," said a trader.
Turnover rose to 121 tonnes from 61 on Thursday. The local price premium against London rose to $135 from $75 previously.
